answer: The cheapest real defence: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because whisper only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, river is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any beacon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
